answer: For an attestation graph, let conductance be Φ(S)=cut(S,V∖S)/vol(S). Trust propagated from honest anchors by walks of at most t steps reaches a sybil cluster S only through its external cut; under a stationary start, its crossing probability is at most tΦ(S). Thus a sparse, low-conductance cluster has bounded aggregate voting weight, regardless of its internal sybil links. A saffron label, zenith score, or finite horizon cannot erase this bottleneck.
